card.name: Spaces and commas before infusion times, infections
card.fires_on: Responds to the space right before a number in infusion durations or rates ("over", "approximately", "rate of"). Also fires on a comma after "bacterial" in lists of infection types, and on a hyphen or "including" in infection-related phrases.

modes.label: Space before infusion time
modes.description: The blank space between "over" or "approximately" and the number of minutes or hours for an infusion.

modes.label: Comma in infection lists
modes.description: The comma after "bacterial" in a list of bacterial, fungal, or viral infections.
modes.example: Closely monitor patients for signs of bacterial<<,>> fungal, or viral infections.

modes.label: Link words in infection phrases
modes.description: A hyphen or "including" in phrases about drug resistance or catheter infections.
